Reads blob: URLs for staged attachments to convert them to data URLs before send.
Reads the blob: URL of a staged attachment to measure and encode it.
Reads a data:/blob: attachment body for the inline text preview.
Reads a staged attachment's blob:/data:/file URI to turn it into a File or a base64 block, the same conversion components/chat/composer.tsx does. Never a network origin.
Fallback client in the gateway server process, which reads the proxy from its environment.
Probes candidate proxies on 127.0.0.1; routing a proxy probe through a proxy would test the wrong thing.

Reads the manifest of the bundled artifact runtime under public/artifact-runtime/. Same-origin static asset, resolved against location.href — never a network origin, and the packaged shell's connect-src would refuse one.
The Remote Browser companion channel, which carries its own pairing and transport guarantees.
Collaboration sessions target a loopback or LAN peer the user paired with directly.

Reads a message part's local attachment URL before upload. A URL outside LOCAL_ATTACHMENT_SCHEMES goes through assertFetchTargetAllowed first, which permits only public http(s) and refuses loopback, LAN and cloud metadata.
Non-Tauri leg only. The desktop path is connectors_http_request, which applies the proxy policy in Rust.
Non-Tauri leg only. The desktop path is connectors_http_request; the provider needs the Rust OAuth loopback anyway.
Web fallback that resolves a bundled asset path against the dev server when @tauri-apps/plugin-fs is absent.
Turns an already-fetched blob:/data:/same-origin media URL into a saved file; the anchor path does no request.
createWebPostHogFetch is the else half of an isTauri() fork: on the desktop the same AI-observability export goes out through createTauriOtlpFetch. Web and mobile have no native leg to take.
The browser arm of the platform transport itself — this is the call the other paths route around.
The browser arm of the streaming transport, whose body already streams natively.
The browser arm of the platform WebSocket adapter itself.
The browser arm of the proxy transport; on Tauri every request crosses into Rust instead.
Guarded by isPluginGatewayAvailable(): the desktop routes plugin egress through the Rust gateway, which applies the policy and the plugin allowlist.
Loads a plugin module from a convertFileSrc asset URL or a local path, never a remote origin.
The WebRTC signaling channel, whose factory is injected by the caller and which negotiates its own transport.
Guarded by isTauri(): the desktop reads skills through the skills_fetch_remote_md Rust command.

The companion transport's own socket, paired with the TLS-pinned fetch in pinned-fetch.ts.

The default postJson, used only when bootstrap.ts injects none. It injects the Rust leg on the desktop, so this runs on web, mobile and the headless brain, where the process environment carries the proxy.

The remote-terminal socket, reached through the same paired-host channel.

Log shipping runs in the Node hosts (headless brain, CLI, sidecar) where the process proxy environment applies.

Talks to the code-server process this app spawned on loopback.
Talks to the loopback relay endpoint the IDE bridge owns.
